purpose: Define point-in-time analyst earnings forecast, revision, consensus and forward-valuation semantics before any Taiwan outcome join.

evidenceContext.taiwan2026Paper: Taiwan index-constituent evidence reports return-predictive content in forecast earnings growth revisions using monthly CMoney consensus forecasts; mechanism support only, not imported alpha.
evidenceContext.taiwanRobustnessCounterevidence: Recent Taiwan thesis evidence finds mixed analyst-characteristic long-short performance and small-cap/outlier sensitivity; revision/dispersion effects are not assumed universal.
evidenceContext.sourceState: Public CMoney pages show dated broker-report EPS forecasts and ranges, but no validated canonical licensed PIT API/history contract has been proven in this repository.

namingFirewall.reason: Existing V8 marketConsensus is an independent-source ranking overlay, not sell-side analyst earnings consensus.

horizonFirewall.rule: Never combine different forecast horizons into one consensus or Forward PE series.

basisFirewall.rule: Do not combine reported/adjusted/broker-defined EPS without an explicit mapping contract.

consensusConstruction.primitive: Preserve every individual forecast vintage. Consensus is derived, never a replacement for detail records.
consensusConstruction.latestPerForecaster: At any asOf timestamp, include at most the latest active forecast from each forecaster/broker identity for the same target horizon and basis.
consensusConstruction.stalenessRule: Do not choose an outcome-optimized stale-forecast cutoff. Preserve age distributions first; cutoff/weighting requires a separately preregistered forecast-accuracy study.
consensusConstruction.coverageRule: No analyst coverage => UNKNOWN, never bearish and never zero.

revisionSemantics.rawDelta: newForecast - priorForecast for same forecaster, metric, basis and target horizon.
revisionSemantics.percentDelta: Only when prior forecast is safely away from zero under a frozen numerical guard; otherwise UNKNOWN.
revisionSemantics.breadth: Track how many independent forecasters revised up/down; one analyst moving the mean is not equivalent to broad revision breadth.
revisionSemantics.timing: Preserve event time relative to earnings/revenue/guidance disclosures; post-announcement revisions are not assumed equally informative.

expectedGrowthSemantics.forecastEarningsGrowth: forecastEPS / comparablePriorActualEPS - 1 only when prior actual EPS is positive, comparable and safely away from zero.
expectedGrowthSemantics.guard: Negative/zero/near-zero prior EPS => ratio FEG UNKNOWN; retain raw expected EPS delta and transition state separately.
expectedGrowthSemantics.reason: Turnaround and deep-cyclical cases can make percentage growth explode or reverse sign.

forwardValuation.forwardPE: price / consensusForecastEPS only for strictly positive compatible forecast EPS and aligned price timestamp.
forwardValuation.forwardEarningsYield: consensusForecastEPS / price may be stored as a separate research primitive when finite, including negative values; it must not be mislabeled PE.
forwardValuation.decomposition: Forward-PE change must be decomposed into price change versus forecast-EPS revision; a lower Forward PE caused by a price collapse is not equivalent to an EPS upgrade.
forwardValuation.priceClock: Use decision-time eligible price, never future close.
forwardValuation.shareDenominatorGuard: EPS basis must remain compatible with corporate-action/share-count semantics.

biasControls: analyst coverage selection by size/liquidity/investor attention
existing fundamentalScore and realized revenue/EPS growth
preregisteredHypotheses: H1 consensus revision direction/magnitude may add information beyond realized growth and existing fundamentalScore.
H2 broad multi-analyst revision breadth may be more robust than a consensus move driven by one forecaster.
H3 revision information content depends on event timing; immediate post-earnings revisions may be less incremental because they largely process public news.
H4 forecast level/FEG is more regime- and sign-dependent than revision direction.
H5 analyst coverage/dispersion may proxy information environment rather than direct alpha and must be tested after size/liquidity/coverage controls.
H6 Forward PE contributes only after separating price-driven cheapening from forecast-driven denominator improvement.

requires: immutable individual forecast vintages or provider-equivalent revision history
